Name: Amaziah, King of Judah
Summary: Amaziah defeated Edom but brought Edom's gods home and worshipped them, then challenged Jehoash of Israel and was captured, and was later slain in a conspiracy at Lachish.
KeyStory: Amaziah defeats Edom, worships its gods, and falls to Jehoash.
RelatedPeople: Jehoash, King of Israel; Jehoaddan, Mother of Amaziah; Joash, King of Judah; Jehoaddan, of Jerusalem
LifeLesson: Victory can become a snare when the victor bows to the gods he just defeated.
